description: Can this payer settle this x402 payment requirement right now? When to use: After an x402 server answered 402 with an XRPL `exact` requirement: to check, before signing, that this payer can settle that exact requirement to that recipient now. Prefer another tool: For a payment that is not an x402 requirement (use `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness`), or once the payment has settled (use `/v1/xrpl/payment/verify`). Example: xrpl_x402_preflight {"asset":"XRP","amount":"10000000","pay_to":"rhub8VRN55s94qWKDv6jmDy1pUykJzF3wq","payer":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"}

amount.description: Amount the requirement asks for: a whole number of drops for XRP, a positive decimal in token units for an issued asset

asset.description: Asset of the x402 requirement: XRP, or the currency code of an issued asset (3 characters, case-sensitive, or 40 hexadecimal characters) whose issuer goes in issuer. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens.

destination_tag.description: Destination tag the requirement states (extra.destinationTag): an integer from 0 to 4294967295; it is passed to the readiness check

issuer.description: Issuer of the asset (extra.issuer of the requirement): a valid classic XRPL address; required unless the asset is XRP

pay_to.description: Account the requirement pays: valid classic XRPL address

payer.description: Wallet that would pay: valid classic XRPL address (r..., checksum verified)

name: xrpl_x402_preflight

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open; null when no read behind the answer names a ledger, never 0

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

blockers.description: Blocking codes: `pay_to_not_wallet`, and each applicable payer readiness blocker or reason prefixed `payer_`

readiness.description: Payment readiness of `payer` sending the amount to `pay_to`: what `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness` answers for the same payment, without its `meta`

amount.description: Amount checked, in units of `asset`: an XRP `amount` is sent to this preflight in drops (the x402 XRPL requirement's unit) and held here in XRP (drops / 1,000,000); an issued currency's `amount` is held as sent, in units of `asset`

asset_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `asset`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP, 3-character codes and MPT ids

credentials.description: Credential entry ids queried, upper case, in request order (echo of `credentials`); null when the request sent none

fee_drops.description: The fee the rules compare, the `standard` tier (`fee.standard_drops`), in drops; null when the fee read failed

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`; for an MPT, the display amount (`value_atomic` / 10^`AssetScale`, exact) when the route read the issuance's `AssetScale`, else null

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

max_sendable.description: Most the source's balance allows it to send now, rounded down (freezes, limits and authorization are reported as reasons, not deducted); for an MPT sent between two holders, the largest whole amount whose cost, rounded as `required_source_balance` says, fits the balance (without `amount` the amendment state is not read and the cost rounds up); for an MPT issuer, the room left below the maximum amount; null when the source is the issuer of a trust-line token or when unknown

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`; for an MPT, the display amount (`value_atomic` / 10^`AssetScale`, exact) when the route read the issuance's `AssetScale`, else null

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

required_source_balance.description: Balance the source must hold for `amount`: XRP adds the larger of the reserve and the fee, a token sent between two holders adds the transfer fee (an MPT rounds that cost to whole base units by the network's rule: up once the `fixCleanup3_5_0` amendment is enabled or when its state is unknown; before it, to nearest with ties to even when the exact cost has at most 16 significant digits, else up); null without `amount` or when unknown

reserve_base_xrp.description: Base reserve the evaluation used, in XRP (server_info validated_ledger.reserve_base_xrp, exact); null when the reserve read failed

reserve_inc_xrp.description: Owner reserve per ledger object the evaluation used, in XRP (server_info validated_ledger.reserve_inc_xrp, exact); null when the reserve read failed

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`; for an MPT, the display amount (`value_atomic` / 10^`AssetScale`, exact) when the route read the issuance's `AssetScale`, else null

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

source_balance.description: The source's balance of the payment asset (an MPT in both units): for XRP its account's Balance, in XRP; for a token its trust line balance; for an MPT its MPToken's MPTAmount; zero when it holds no line or MPToken; null when that read failed, the source is missing or it is the asset's issuer

source_owner_count.description: The source's `OwnerCount`, the objects its owner reserve counts; null when the source is missing or unread

spendable_xrp.description: Source XRP above the larger of its live reserve and the `standard` fee tier; null when not computable

transfer_fee_pct.description: Issuer transfer fee in percent, when it applies

verdict.description: `not_ready` on any blocking reason; else `unknown` on any failed sub-check
`block` on any blocker, `warn` with warnings only, else `ok`

warnings.description: Non-blocking codes: `asset_not_canonical`, `payer_readiness_unknown`, and payer readiness warnings prefixed `payer_`
